descriptions.text: Enriched Pet Biscuit. “The Paramour.” This is a unique item. Okay, so we all know by now what enhanced pet biscuits do. While extremely valuable, enhanced pet biscuits are items that leave the result up to chance, and when you feed your pet one, there’s a very real risk you’ll be saying goodbye to your furry friend forever. Or they’ll be saying goodbye to you. … This is an Enriched Pet Biscuit. This leaves nothing to chance. These are highly refined pet biscuits with a known result. This biscuit imparts the “Paramour” benefit. …

beats.headline: Three from a celestial box
beats.text: Prepotente puts a glowing little treat on the table. He got it in a celestial box, one of three, and they are not the run-of-the-mill enhanced biscuit: one is Nothing Special Party Companion, one is Nothing Special, and this one. Carl picks it up. Enriched Pet Biscuit, "The Paramour": a known result, an upright transformation, a reset to level one, crawler status for a dungeon-born pet, and a permanent, incurable charm that makes the eater fall hopelessly in love with whoever fed it to them. Nothing Special makes a creature a dungeon pet in juvenile form. The Party Companion one keeps its existing form and gives no ability to talk.

beats.headline: Absolutely not
beats.text: Prepotente wants advice. Her name is Ragazzaccia, and she was his girlfriend before the dungeon. Absolutely not, says Donut: he will not be turning anyone into a sex slave. With the other two biscuits, he protests, she would stay a regular goat, and it is not called that: it is called Paramour. Donut points out that she would be a level-one crawler, not allowed in a pet carrier or his safe room, and would get hurt. Nobody will like him if he uses that biscuit on anything. Don't use it. Ever. Right, Carl? Carl is still caught up on the biscuit that stops a pet from talking, and wonders aloud whether it is too late to give that one to Donut.

beats.headline: Penelope 3
beats.text: In the back of the truck Penny the pig is eating a chicken sandwich, already in the front of the harness. Carl examines her: Crawler #12,953,454, "Penelope 3," level 10, Yorkshire Pig, no class. They fed her the Nothing Special Party Companion biscuit, which made her a sapient party member without the ability to talk out loud, not that it stops her using chat. Because Carl fed it to her she is in a party with him. He has blown up whole settlements, thousands of NPCs dead by his hand, yet dragging a pig into sapience feels like a line he never knew was there, especially since he means to use her as bait.

beats.headline: Search and combine
beats.text: Every inventory has swapped hands and Donut is holding Carl's. Racing at the centipede, he yells for her to combine the ball in his hotlist's slot ten with the biscuit in slot twelve. Her hotlist only has ten slots. Search and combine, he shouts, fast. She finds it and drops the ball into his xistera, and he flings the banger sphere with the biscuit inside straight into Scolopendra's yawning mouth. The biggest, baddest entity in the dungeon splatters onto the arena floor, a gelatinous puddle the size of a small elephant.

beats.headline: The wrong biscuit
beats.text: By the biscuit's description, the boss should come out of the goo a regular pet at level one, to live in a pet carrier in Carl's inventory: if he dies, she dies, a true fail-safe. Then Donut tells him not to get mad. With the inventory moving so fast, she made a mistake. The gelatin drains away to a human-sized centipede, and a new member joins the party: Sexy Scolopendra, level 1, a crawler, with a humanlike face, giant lips, no arms and a red bow on one feeler. She is not a pet. Donut gave him the wrong pet biscuit. Hi, Carl, she says, and boops his nose.
